annotations.title: Create a payment session (MPP upfront hold)

description: Opens a payment session: POST /v1/sessions with amount_units (6-decimal USDC units) and ttl_seconds. The API returns session_id with state 'created'; the payer then authorizes the session (phantom_authorize_session / the API authorize endpoint) and the seller captures against it (phantom_capture_session). Created sessions expire after ttl_seconds if never authorized. Quoting/creating never moves funds — funds move only on capture.

amount_units.description: Maximum amount of the session in smallest units (6 decimals for USDC), e.g. '5000000' = $5.00.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live of the session in seconds (positive integer; the session expires if not authorized/used within this window).

name: phantom_create_session

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
